answer_2.quote: The classical automated metrics (FAD, KL, IS, and CLAP), as well as our three new scores (EOS, ESS, and AHQ) are employed to quantitatively evaluate and compare different model variants.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a user study where two human annotators evaluate and select the better output based on each criterion.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare two audio outputs and choose the better one for event occurrence, event sequence, and acoustic & harmonic quality.
